en.headline: AFCD Leisure Nature Chill Fun Expo continues today in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: The free two-day event at East Point City runs from noon to 7pm, featuring exhibitions, workshops and sales of local agricultural and fisheries products.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department’s “Leisure·Nature·Chill & Fun” Expo continues today at the first-floor atrium of East Point City in Hang Hau, Tseung Kwan O.

The event, which opened on Saturday, runs from noon to 7pm both days and is free to enter. It includes themed exhibitions, workshops, guided tours, seminars, game booths and Hong Kong Harvest stalls selling local products.

The Department said the expo introduces Hong Kong’s agriculture, fisheries and natural ecology, and encourages the public to explore leisure farming and fishing experiences. Workshops and tours have limited on-site registration on a first-come, first-served basis; seminars require no advance booking.

zh.headline: 漁護署「漁農自然Chill好玩」博覽今續於將軍澳
zh.dek: 免費兩日活動於東港城1樓中庭中午至晚上7時舉行，設展覽、工作坊及本地農漁業產品銷售。
body: 漁農自然護理署舉辦的「漁農自然Chill好玩」博覽今於將軍澳坑口東港城1樓中庭續續舉行。
活動周六已開幕，兩日均由中午12時至晚上7時，免費入場。內容包括主題展覽、工作坊、導賞團、講座、攤位遊戲及「優鮮港品」銷售攤位。
漁護署表示，博覽介紹香港漁農文化及自然生態資源，鼓勵市民體驗休閒漁農活動。工作坊及導賞團設有限即場報名，先到先得；講座無需預先報名。
